A solution means demonstrated sustainable product economics, rather than merely raising capital or announcing a plan.
I use calendar 2025, the latest completed annual reporting period before publication, consistent with the surrounding discussion of these private companies' 2025 economics.

criteria.support_condition: Comparable financial evidence must establish that no startup in the relevant population improved its gross margin during the target period, and that none demonstrated sustainable product economics.
criteria.contradiction_condition: One qualifying startup with comparable improving gross margins, or demonstrated sustainable product economics, would refute the universal assertion. A definitive financial verdict also requires an identifiable accounting basis.
